text:
sam_k: Hey — in Lisbon for a conference and my wallet got stolen. Need same-day specialist appointment for toddler vaccine tomorrow; clinic says they need proof of coverage (policy/group/effective dates) and insurer phone to verify. Can't access digital ID because phone's being serviced. Can People Ops generate a PDF proof of coverage we can send to the clinic? Also, what do I need to submit later for reimbursement in EUR? @jamie_hr @alex_benefits
jamie_hr: Oh no, sorry. Yes, we can. Quick Qs: what's the plan name on your card and dependent name/DOB?
sam_k: Plan shows "Redwood Core PPO". Dependent: Luca Samuels, 2020-06-15. Member ID ends in 7890, group # 44512 — but physical card is gone. My local number is +351 9xx xxx xxx.
alex_benefits: We can produce a same-day proof letter. I need the full member ID or attach passport/birth cert. If you can't upload here, email benefits@redwood.com and CC me. For foreign currency receipts: keep originals and we'll reimburse at the bank rate on date of service — submit via the benefits portal selecting "international" and attach exchange rate screenshot.
sam_k: I'll email in ~10m. Does the letter include insurer phone for verification? Clinic insists on calling an insurer line.
ben_payments: FYI reimbursements go through GlobalClaims (3rd-party). Their verification line is +1-555-0123 for admins; for local international assistance we provide +44-20-555-0099. I'll add that phone to the letter.
benefits-bot: Automessage: Proof of coverage letters typically include plan name, member ID, group number, effective dates, dependent names, contact numbers, and billing address. Expedited requests processed within 4 business hours.
jamie_hr: Marking urgent. @alex_benefits will draft the letter and upload a secure PDF link. Sam — please reply here after you send the docs so we can track.
sam_k: Sent email with passport photo attached and short note. Thanks!
alex_benefits: Got it, drafting now. Will upload secure OneDrive link and share. Note: if the provider requests prior auth for the vaccine we may need extra steps, but usually vaccines are covered; you'll be fine to submit as out-of-network claim if necessary.
sam_k: Clinic accepted the digital letter and booked the appointment. Huge help :pray:
